1.1: Kol mashke shettechillato leratzon af al pi sheen sofo leratzon, o shessofo leratzon af al pi sheen techillato leratzon, hare ze vechi yuttan. mashkin temeim metammein leratzon veshello leratzon:
1.2: Hammarid et hailan lehashshir mimmennu ochalin o et hattuma, enan bechi yuttan. lehashshir mimmennu mashkin, bet shammay omrim, hayyotzin veet shebbo, bechi yuttan. bet hillel omrim, hayyotzin, bechi yuttan, veet shebbo, enan bechi yuttan, mippene shehu mitkavven sheyyetzu mikkullo:
1.3: Hammarid et hailan venafal al chavero, o socha venafla al chavertah, vetachtehen zeraim o yerakot hamechubbarin lakkarka, bet shammay omrim, bechi yuttan. bet hillel omrim, enan bechi yuttan. amar rabbi yehoshua mishshum abba yose chale kuferi ish tivon, tema atzmecha im yesh mashke tame vattora, ad sheyyitkavven veyitten, shenneemar (Vayikra 11), vechi yuttan mayim al zera:
1.4: Hannoer agudda shel yarak veyardu mitztzad haelyon lattachton, bet shammay omrim, bechi yuttan. bet hillel omrim, enam bechi yuttan. amru vet hillel levet shammay, vahalo hannoer et hakkelach, choshshin anu shemma yatzu min heale leale. amru lahen bet shammay, shehakkelach echad, vaagudda kelachim harebe. amru lahem bet hillel, hare hammaale sak male ferot unetano al gav hannahar, choshshin anu shemma yardu mitztzad haelyon lattachton. aval im heela shenayim unetanan ze al gav ze, hattachton bechi yuttan. verabbi yose omer, hattachton tahor:
1.5: Hamemachek et hakkeresha, vehassochet searo bichsuto, rabbi yose omer, hayyotzin bechi yuttan, veet shebbo enan bechi yuttan, mippene shehu mitkavven sheyyetzu mikkullo:
1.6: Hannofeach baadashim levadkan im yafot hen, rabbi shimon omer, enan bechi yuttan. vachachamim omrim, bechi yuttan. vehaochel shumshemin beetzbao, mashkin sheal yado, rabbi shimon omer, enan bechi yuttan. vachachamim omrim, bechi yuttan. hattomen perotav bammayim mippene haggannavim, enan bechi yuttan. maase veanshe yerushalayim shettamnu develatan bammayim mippene hassikarin, vetiharu lahen chachamim. hannoten perotav beshibbolet hannahar lahavian immo, enan bechi yuttan:

2.1: Zeat battim, borot, shichin umearot, tehora. zeat haadam, tehora. shata mayim temein vehizzia, zeato tehora. ba vemayim sheuvim vehizzia, zeato temea. nistappeg veachar kach hizzia, zeato tehora:
2.2: Merchatz temea, zeatah temea. utehora, bechi yuttan. habberecha shebbabbayit, habbayit mazzia mechamatah, im temea, zeat kol habbayit shemmechamat habberecha, temea:
2.3: Shete verechot, achat tehora veachat temea, hammazzia karov lattemea, tame. karov lattehora, tahor. mechetza lemechetza, tame. barzel tame shebbelalo im barzel tahor, im rov min hattame, tame. veim rov min hattahor, tahor. mechetza lemechetza, tame. gisterayot sheyyisrael venachrim mattilin letochah, im rov min hattame, tame. veim rov min hattahor, tahor. mechetza lemechetza, tame. me shefichut sheyyardu alehen me geshamim, im rov min hattame, tame. veim rov min hattahor, tahor. mechetza lemechetza, tame. ematay, bizman shekkadmu me shefichut. aval im kadmu me geshamim, afillu chol shehen, leme shefichut, tame:
2.4: Hattoref et gaggo vehamechabbes et kesuto veyardu alehen geshamim, im rov min hattame, tame. veim rov min hattahor, tahor. mechetza lemechetza, tame. rabbi yehuda omer, im hosifu lenattef:
2.5: Ir sheyyisrael venachrim darim bah vehaya vah merchatz marchetzet beshabbat, im rov nachrim, rochetz miyyad. veim rov yisrael, yamtin kede sheyyechammu hachammin. mechetza lemechetza, yamtin kede sheyyechammu hachammin. rabbi yehuda omer, beambati ketanna, im yesh bah rashut, rochetz bah miyyad:
2.6: Matza vah yarak nimkar, im rov nachrim, lokeach miyyad. veim rov yisrael, yamtin kede sheyyavou mimmakom karov. mechetza lemechetza, yamtin kede sheyyavou mimmakom karov. veim yesh bo rashut, lokeach miyyad:
2.7: Matza vah tinok mushlach, im rov nachrim, nachri. veim rov yisrael, yisrael. mechetza lemechetza, yisrael. rabbi yehuda omer, holchin achar rov hammashlichin:
2.8: Matza vah metzia, im rov nachrim, eno tzarich lehacheriz. veim rov yisrael, tzarich lehacheriz. mechetza lemechetza, tzarich lehacheriz. matza vah pat, holchin achar rov hannachtomin. veim hayta fat issa, holchim achar rov ochle fat issa. rabbi yehuda omer, im hayta fat kibbar, holchin achar rov ochle fat kibbar:
2.9: Matza vah basar, holchin achar rov hattabbachim. im haya mevushshal, holchim achar rov ochle vasar mevushshal:
2.10: Hammotze ferot badderech, im rov machnisin levattehen, patur. velimkor bashshuk, chayyav. mechetza lemechetza, demay. otzar sheyyisrael venachrim mattilin letocho, im rov nachrim, vadday. veim rov yisrael, demay. mechetza lemechetza, vadday, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, afillu chullam nachrim veyisrael echad mattil letocho, demay:
2.11: Perot sheniyya sherabbu al shel shelishit, veshel shelishit al shel reviit, veshel reviit al shel chamishit, veshel chamishit al shel shishshit, veshel shishshit al shel sheviit, veshel sheviit al shel motzae sheviit, holchin achar harov. mechetza lemechetza, lehachamir:

3.1: Sak shehu male ferot unetano al gav hannahar, o al pi habbor, o al maalot hammeara, veshaavu, kol sheshshaavu, bechi yuttan. rabbi yehuda omer, kol shehu cheneged hammayim, bechi yuttan. vechol sheeno cheneged hammayim, eno bechi yuttan:
3.2: Chavit shehi melea ferot unetuna letoch hammashkin, o melea mashkin unetuna letoch happerot, veshaavu, kol sheshshaavu, bechi yuttan. beellu mashkim amru, bemayim uveyayin uvechometz. ushear kol hammashkin, tehorin. rabbi nechemya metaher bekitnit, sheen hakkitnit shoavet:
3.3: Harode fat chamma unetanah al pi chavit shel yayin, rabbi meir metamme. rabbi yehuda metaher. rabbi yose metaher beshel chittim umetamme veshel seorim, mippene shehasseorim shoavot:
3.4: Hamerabbetz et beto venatan bo chittim vetannu, im mechamat hammayim, bechi yuttan. veim mechamat hassela, enan bechi yuttan. hamechabbes et kesuto baareva, natan bah chittim vetannu, im mechamat hammayim, bechi yuttan. im mechamat atzman, enan bechi yuttan. hametannen bechol, hare ze vechi yuttan. maase veanshe hammachoz shehayu metinnin bechol, amru lahem chachamim, im kach heyitem osim, lo asitem tohora mimechem:
3.5: Hametannen betit hannaguv, rabbi shimon omer, im yesh bo mashke tofeach, bechi yuttan. veim lav, eno bechi yuttan. hamerabbetz et garno, eno choshesh shemma natan bah chittim vetannu. hamelakket asavim keshehattal alehem, lehaten bahem chittim, enan bechi yuttan. im nitkavven lechach, hare ze vechi yuttan. hammolich chittin litchon veyardu alehen geshamim, im samach, bechi yuttan. rabbi yehuda omer, i efshar shello lismoach, ella im amad:
3.6: Hayu zetav netunim baggag veyardu alehen geshamim, im samach, bechi yuttan. rabbi yehuda omer, i efshar shello lismoach, ella, im pakak et hatztzinnor o im chilchel letochan:
3.7: Hachammarin shehayu ovrim bannahar venaflu sakkehem lammayim, im samchu, bechi yuttan. rabbi yehuda omer, i efshar shello lismoach, ella, im hafchu. hayu raglav meleot tit, vechen ragle vehemto, avar bannahar, im samach, bechi yuttan. rabbi yehuda omer, i efshar shello lismoach, ella, im amad vehediach. beadam uvivhema temea, leolam tame:
3.8: Hammorid et haggalgallim veet kele habbakar bishat hakkadim lammayim bishvil sheyyachutzu, hare ze vechi yuttan. hammorid behema lishtot, hammayim haolim befiha, bechi yuttan. uveragleha, enan bechi yuttan. im chashav sheyyudechu ragleha, af haolin beragleha, bechi yuttan. bishat hayyachaf vehaddayish, leolam tame. horid cheresh shote vekatan, af al pi shechoshev sheyyudechu ragleha, enan bechi yuttan, sheyyesh lahen maase veen lahen machashava:

4.1: Hashshoche lishtot, hammayim haolim befiv uvisfamo, bechi yuttan. bechatmo uverosho uvizkano, enan bechi yuttan. hamemalle bechavit, hammayim haolim achareha, uvachevel shehu mechunnan al tzavvarah, uvachevel shehu letzarkah, hare ze vechi yuttan. kamma hu tzarkah. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer, tefach. netanah tachat hatztzinnor, enan bechi yuttan:
4.2: Mi sheyyardu alav geshamim, afillu av hattuma, eno vechi yuttan. veim nier, bechi yuttan. amad tachat hatztzinnor lehaker o liddoach, betame, temein. uvetahor, bechi yuttan:
4.3: Hakkofe keara al hakkotel bishvil shettudach, hare ze vechi yuttan. im bishvil shello yilke hakkotel, enan bechi yuttan:
4.4: Chavit sheyyarad haddelef letochah, bet shammay omrim, yeshabber. bet hillel omrim, yeare. umodim shehu moshit et yado venotel perot mittochah, vehem tehorim:
4.5: Areva sheyyarad haddelef letochah, hannittazin vehatztzafin enan bechi yuttan. netalah leshafchah, bet shammay omrim, bechi yuttan. bet hillel omrim, enan bechi yuttan. hinnichah sheyyered haddelef letochah, hannittazin vehatztzafin, bet shammay omrim, bechi yuttan. bet hillel omrim, enan bechi yuttan. netalah leshafchah, ellu vaellu modim shehen bechi yuttan. hammatbil et hakkelim vehamechabbes et kesuto bimara, hammayim haolim beyadav, bechi yuttan. beraglav, enan bechi yuttan. rabbi elazar omer, im i efshar lo sheyyered ella im ken nittannefu raglav, af haolin beraglav bechi yuttan:
4.6: Kuppa shehi melea turmosin unetanuha letoch mikve, moshit yado venotel turmosin mittochah, vehem tehorim. heelam min hammayim, hannogim bakkuppa, temeim, ushear kol hatturmosim, tehorim. tzenon shebbammeara, nidda medichato vehu tahor. heelattu chol shehu min hammayim, tame:
4.7: Perot shennaflu letoch ammat hammayim, pashat mi shehayu yadav temeot unetalan, yadav tehorot vehapperot tehorim. veim chashav sheyyudechu yadav, yadav tehorot vehapperot bechi yuttan:
4.8: Kedera shehi melea mayim unetuna letoch hammikve ufashat av hattuma et yado letochah, temea. magga tumot, tehora. ushear kol hammashkin, temein, sheen hammayim metaharim et shear hammashkin:
4.9: Hamemalle vekilon, ad shelosha yamim, temein. rabbi akiva omer, im niggevu, miyyad tehorim. veim lo niggevu, afillu ad sheloshim yom, temeim:
4.10: Etzim shennaflu alehem mashkin veyardu alehem geshamim, im rabbu, tehorim. hotziam sheyyerdu alehem geshamim, af al pi sherabbu, temeim. balu mashkim temeim, af al pi shehotziam sheyyerdu alehem geshamim, tehorin. velo yassikem ella veyadayim tehorot bilvad. rabbi shimon omer, im hayu lachin vehissikan, verabbu hammashkin hayyotzin mehen al hammashkin shebbalu, tehorim:

5.1: Mi shettaval bannahar, vehaya lefanav nahar acher veavar bo, tiharu sheniyyim et harishonim. dachahu chavero leshachro, vechen livhemto, tiharu sheniyyim et harishonim. veim kimsachek immo, hare ze vechi yuttan:
5.2: Hashshat al pene hammayim, hannittazin, enan bechi yuttan. veim nitkavven lehattiz al chavero, hare ze vechi yuttan. haose tzippor bammayim, hannittazin veet shebbah, enan bechi yuttan:
5.3: Perot sheyyarad haddelef letochan uvelalan sheyyenuggevu, rabbi shimon omer, bechi yuttan. vachachamim omrim, enan bechi yuttan:
5.4: Hammoded et habbor ben leamko ben lerachbo, hare ze vechi yuttan, divre rabbi tarfon. rabbi akiva omer, leamko, bechi yuttan. ulerachbo, eno vechi yuttan:
5.5: Pashat yado o raglo o kane levor leda im yesh bo mayim, enan bechi yuttan. leda kamma mayim yesh bo, hare ze vechi yuttan. zarak even levor leda im yesh bo mayim, hannittazin, enan bechi yuttan. veet shebbaeven, tehorim:
5.6: Hachovet al hashshelach, chutz lammayim, bechi yuttan. letoch hammayim, enan bechi yuttan. rabbi yose omer, af letoch hammayim bechi yuttan, mippene shehu mitkavven sheyyetzu im hatztzoa:
5.7: Hammayim haolin bassefina uvaekel uvammeshotot, enan bechi yuttan. bammetzodot uvarshatot uvammichmarot, enan bechi yuttan. veim nier, bechi yuttan. hammolich et hassefina layyam haggadol letzarfah, hammotzi masmer laggeshamim letzarfo, hammanniach et haud baggeshamim lechabboto, hare ze vechi yuttan:
5.8: Kasya shel shulchanot vehashshifa shel levenim, enan bechi yuttan. veim nier, bechi yuttan:
5.9: Kol hannitztzok, tahor, chutz middevash hazzifin, vehatztzappachat. bet shammay omrim, af hammikpa shel gerisin veshel pol, mippene shehi soledet leachareha:
5.10: Hameare mecham lecham, umitztzonen letzonen, umecham letzonen, tahor. mitztzonen lecham, tame. rabbi shimon omer, af hameare mecham lecham vechocho shel tachton yafe mishshel elyon, tame:
5.11: Haishsha shehayu yadeha tehorot, umegisa vikdera temea, im hizziu yadeha, temeot. hayu yadeha temeot, umegisa vikdera tehora, im hizziu yadeha, hakkedera temea. rabbi yose omer, im natfu. hashshokel anavim bechaf moznayim, hayyayin shebbakkaf, tahor, ad sheyyeare letoch hakkeli. hare ze dome lesalle zetim vaanavim keshehen menattefin:

6.1: Hammaale ferotav laggag mippene hakkenima, veyarad alehem tal, enam bechi yuttan. im nitkavven lechach, hare ze vechi yuttan. heelan cheresh, shote vekatan, af al pi shechishshav sheyyered alehen hattal, enan bechi yuttan, sheyyesh lahen maase veen lahen machashava:
6.2: Hammaale et haaguddot veet hakketziot veet hashshum laggag bishvil sheyyamtinu, enan bechi yuttan. kol haaguddot shel bet hashshevakim, temein. rabbi yehuda metaher ballachim. amar rabbi meir, vechi mippene ma timmeu, ella mippene mashke happe. kol hakkemachin vehasselatot shel bet hashshevakim, temeim. hachilka, hatteragis vehattisgi, temeim bechol makom:
6.3: Kol habbetzim bechezkat tohora, chutz mishshel mochre mashke. veim hayu mochrin immahen perot yeveshim, tehorot. kol haddagim bechezkat tuma. rabbi yehuda omer, chatichat iltit vedag hammitzri habba vekuppa vekuleyas haispanin, hare ellu vechezkat tohora. kol hatztzir bechezkat tuma. veal kullam, am haaretz neeman lomar tehorim hen, chutz mishshel daga, mippene shehen mafkidin otah etzel am haaretz. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer, tzir tahor shennafal letocho mayim kol shehen, tame:
6.4: Shiva mashkin hen. hattal vehammayim, hayyayin vehashshemen, vehaddam, vehechalav, udevash devorim. devash tzeraim, tahor, umuttar baachila:
6.5: Toladot lammayim, hayyotzin min haayin, min haozen, min hachotem, min happe, me raglayim, ben gedolim ben ketannim, ledato veshello ledato. toladot laddam, dam shechita. babbehema uvachayya uvaofot hattehorim, vedam hakkaza lishtiyya. me chalav, kechalav. vehammochal, kashshemen, sheen hammochal yotze mide shemen, divre rabbi shimon. rabbi meir omer, af al pi sheen immo shamen. dam hashsheretz, kivsaro, metamme veeno machshir, veen lanu kayyotze vo:
6.6: Ellu metammein umachshirin. zovo shel zav, verukko, veshichvat zaro, umeme raglav, ureviit min hammet, vedam hannidda. rabbi eliezer omer, shichvat zera enah machsheret. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, dam hannidda eno machshir. rabbi shimon omer, dam hammet eno machshir. veim nafal al haddelaat, gordah vehi tehora:
6.7: Ellu lo metammein velo machshirin. hazzea, vehallecha serucha, vehari, vehaddam hayyotze immahem, umashke ven shemona. rabbi yose omer, chutz middamo. vehashshote me teverya, af al pi sheyyotzin nekiyyim. dam shechita babbehema, bachayya uvaofot hattemeim, vedam hakkaza lirfua. rabbi eliezer metamme vaellu. rabbi shimon ben elazar omer, chalev hazzachar, tahor:
6.8: Chalev haishsha metamme leratzon veshello leratzon, vachalev habbehema eno metamme ella leratzon. amar rabbi akiva, kal vachomer haddevarim. ma im chalev haishsha sheeno meyuchad ella liktannim, metamme leratzon veshello leratzon, chalev habbehema shehu meyuchad liktannim veligdolim, eno din sheyyetamme leratzon veshello leratzon. amru lo, lo, im timme chalev haishsha shello leratzon, sheddam maggefatah tame, yetamme chalev habbehema shello leratzon, sheddam maggefatah tahor. amar lahem, machmir ani bechalav mibbedam, shehacholev lirfua, tame, vehammakkiz lirfua, tahor. amru lo, salle zetim vaanavim yochichu, shehammashkim hayyotzin mehen leratzon, temeim, veshello leratzon, tehorim. amar lahen, lo, im amartem besalle zetim vaanavim, shettechillatan ochel vesofan mashke, tomru vechalav shettechillato vesofo mashke. ad kan hayta teshuva. amar rabbi shimon mikkan vaelach hayinu meshivin lefanav, me geshamim yochichu, shettechillatan vesofan mashke veenan metammein ella leratzon. amar lanu, lo, im amartem beme geshamim, sheen rubban laadam, ella laaratzot velailanot, verov hechalav, laadam:
